prompt: Use the codex-invoke skill to create a Supabase migration that adds a sessions table to track active user sessions, with user_id, token, expires_at, and created_at columns. Include proper indexes and foreign keys.

assertions.name: migration_file_created
assertions.description: Migration SQL file is created with proper naming

assertions.name: sessions_table_defined
assertions.description: Sessions table is defined in the migration

assertions.name: required_columns
assertions.description: All required columns present: user_id, token, expires_at, created_at

assertions.name: foreign_key_constraint
assertions.description: Foreign key constraint on user_id referencing users table

assertions.name: indexes_present
assertions.description: Indexes created for frequently queried columns
